articles_and_episodes.title: THE BRENNAN BAROMETER: Split Your Vote to Keep the Left Out
THE FOURTH ESTATE: Maree Buscke with Dane Giraud & Peter Williams: Election Overhang Threatens to Reshape Parliament
DON BRASH & MATT ROBSON: Former Reserve Bank Governor & Auckland Barrister: Political Opposites Find Common Ground
ALEX PRICE: ACT Candidate For Mount Albert: Cost of Living Blamed for Falling Birth Rate​
PETER WILLIAMS ON POLITICS: National’s Overhang Problem is Finally Out in the Open

youtube.title: THE FOURTH ESTATE
youtube.summary: Maree Buscke is joined by Peter Williams and Dane Giraud to discuss the case of Dr David Smiley, whose dealings with the Medical Council led to a lengthy disciplinary process and his departure for Canada. They question the powers of professional regulators and the limited media coverage, before turning to RNZ’s reporting of The Opportunity Party, the Greens’ engagement with gangs, strategic voting, the projected parliamentary overhang and what election coverage should focus on. For election news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday and find out everything about the overhang, wasted vote and tactical voting at Vote Smart

youtube.title: THE BRENNAN BAROMETER
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan dropped by to give his end-of-week political barometer, and he wasn’t holding back. The message was crystal clear — tactical voting isn’t just smart, it’s the *only* weapon voters have right now to stop a Left bloc collision. Want to know how? Check out VoteSmart before it’s too late.

youtube.title: DON BRASH & MATT ROBSON
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan is rejoined by Don Brash and Matthew Robson to discuss claims linking diversity policies to the Navy ship Manawanui sinking, rising defence spending and New Zealand’s military alignment with the United States. They debate whether closer ties with BRICS could diversify trade, the implications of overseas elections and whether strategic vote-splitting could reshape the election result. For further information check out the PADCA Public Access drive For election news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday and find out everything about the overhang, wasted vote and tactical voting at Vote Smart

youtube.title: ALEX PRICE
youtube.summary: Maree Buscke interviews Alex Price, ACT candidate for Mount Albert and CEO of Fertility Associates, about healthcare inefficiencies, public-private cooperation and declining birth rates. Alex argues that better use of private providers could reduce waiting times, while housing and childcare costs contribute to smaller families. For more from Alex Price or find him on Facebook For election news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday and find out everything about the overhang, wasted vote and tactical voting at Vote Smart

youtube.title: FRANK SALTER
youtube.summary: Frank Salter tackled the thorny topic of Anglophobia head-on, diving deep into academic theories of race, ethnicity, and nationalism. Together with Tim Wilms, they unpack whether multiculturalism truly delivers on its universal promise — or whether it’s been selectively applied, leaving some groups conveniently overlooked in the process.

youtube.title: PETER WILLIAMS ON POLITICS
youtube.summary: Peter Williams examines how electorate-seat wins could increase the size of the next Parliament beyond its usual 120 members, with National potentially facing an overhang and Te Pāti Māori already projected to gain additional seats. For election news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday and find out everything about the overhang, wasted vote and tactical voting at Vote Smart

youtube.title: HUGO LENNON
youtube.summary: A fired-up nationalist took the mic to talk about his mission to defend Australian culture — starting on TikTok and expanding nationwide. He got candid about whether infiltrating mainstream political parties is the real play, or if building something entirely new is the smarter move. Bold ideas, zero filter.
